content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Converting crypto to local currency is the operational step that determines whether crypto payments are practically useful for a creator in a restricted market. In Nigeria, the most established route is USDT to naira through Binance P2P or local exchanges including Patricia and Quidax. Rates are consistently within 2 to 5 percent of the parallel market rate. In Ghana, cedis conversion happens through Binance P2P and active local P2P communities. In Kenya, USDT to Kenyan shilling is available through M-Pesa integrations on several exchanges. Average conversion time across all these markets is 20 to 30 minutes.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to receive USDT payments. Set the webhook URL in your NOWPayments settings to point to your Cloudflare Worker. This will ensure real-time payment verification. Next, set up your Cloudflare Worker with the necessary logic to handle incoming payment confirmations and trigger product delivery from your Supabase database or Google Drive. Ensure that you test this pipeline thoroughly to confirm that transactions process smoothly.
Control your payment infrastructure with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything set up, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital products through your chosen channels. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments webhook will notify your Cloudflare Worker, which will then process the payment and deliver the product. Monitor the first few transactions closely to ensure everything functions as expected. This step is crucial for building confidence in your new infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is stable, consider scaling your operations. You can add more products, optimize your Cloudflare Worker for better performance, and explore additional channels for marketing. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can seamlessly integrate more functionalities such as advanced user tracking, enhanced security measures, and automated email notifications for your customers. Scaling is about enhancing your architecture to meet growing demand.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Instant crypto payments mean no more waiting for delayed payouts.

If you're looking for a comprehensive approach to payment processing, check out the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This solution combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to streamline your operations. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore the full range of options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments, integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers setup. Configure the webhook to connect payment confirmations with your product delivery system, ensuring automatic fulfillment for your buyers.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on networks like Tron or Solana are processed almost instantly, usually within seconds, compared to PayPal, which can take hours or even days due to manual processing and fund availability checks.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators in Nigeria can use peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These platforms offer competitive rates and facilitate direct transactions between users, providing a quick solution for cashing out.
What are the transaction fees for USDT on Tron?
Transaction fees for USDT on the Tron network are typically under $0.10 per transaction. This low cost makes it an efficient choice for digital product sales, keeping your overhead minimal.
Can I use NOWPayments for multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to diversify your payment options and cater to a broader audience of buyers interested in different digital currencies.
